integrity: Mathematical proof and standalone finite checker supplied. Finite tests are not proof of the unrestricted results. No independent review.
scientific_limitations: Only finite connected Cayley structures with every generator separately named as an oriented binary edge predicate. Uncoloured graphs, non-generating marks, counting quantifiers and functional group languages are outside scope. Earlier full-length Cayley logic papers not available for comparison; priority provisional.
title: Two and three variables completely classify finite marked Cayley digraphs
